scope: completed ISET Table-III benchmark breadth rows

naive_bayes.interpretation: Moderately useful ranking but a mismatched fixed operating point. Because the paper omits the Naive Bayes variant and decision procedure, this row does not support a strong impossibility conclusion.

arima_pooled_110_residual_mse.interpretation: Fundamental score-direction failure for this completion. Several attacks flatten the profile and therefore reduce rather than increase residual MSE; no threshold in the paper direction approaches the reported operating point.

one_class_svm_capped.interpretation: Useful ranking but no threshold recovers the reported high-DR/low-FA point. This remains a 12k-train/30k-test resource-capped diagnostic.

statistical_boundary: Rows are correlated within meters and malicious siblings are deterministic transforms of the same benign profiles. Per-row binomial significance would be pseudo-replication; repeated model seeds and meter-level clustered uncertainty are required for confirmatory inference.
